d16: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d16: 🕯️ Li Brown is dead — dehydration. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d16: What Li kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d16: "Li's gone." Maureen looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Li." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d16: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Katarina blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d16: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d16: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d16: 📖 LEARNED: Research & Records (Level 1). Find information fast: indexes, archives, and asking the right question.
d16: 📖 LEARNED: Generous Heart (Level 1). Donating gives 2x trust.
d16: 📖 LEARNED: Soft Step (Level 1). Move through woods like weather. Less noise, fewer surprises.
d16: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"

d16: The fire knew Katarina before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.
